_comment: VSCode ships a `bibtex` language and grammar in its built-in LaTeX extension, but no language configuration at all — no bracket matching, no auto-closing, no comment toggle. This is that missing half. The grammar stays the built-in one; the real colouring comes from the server's semantic tokens.
_wordPattern: A citation key is one word: double-clicking `knuth1984` or `knuth-1984:tlp` selects all of it, and completion filters on the whole thing rather than the fragment after the last dash.
